name: Tokyo Station

exits.name: Marunouchi Central Exit
exits.leads_to: Imperial Palace, Marunouchi red brick facade, business district

exits.name: Yaesu Central Exit
exits.leads_to: Tokaido Shinkansen ticket gates, Highway bus terminal, Tokyo Character Street

exits.name: Nihombashi Exit
exits.leads_to: Express buses and Nihombashi financial district

tips: The Shinkansen platforms (Tokaido / Sanyo towards Kyoto/Osaka) are located on the Yaesu (East) side.
Changing from local JR platforms to the Keiyo Line (for Tokyo Disneyland) takes 10–15 minutes walking through long underground passageways.
Tokyo Character Street (Pokemon, Ghibli, Sanrio) is located on the B1 level of First Avenue Tokyo Station on the Yaesu side.

floors.name: 2F Elevated Shinkansen Platforms
floors.name_ja: 2F 新幹線ホーム
lines: Platforms 14–19: Tokaido & Sanyo Shinkansen (to Kyoto, Shin-Osaka, Hiroshima)
Platforms 20–23: Tohoku, Joetsu & Hokuriku Shinkansen (to Sendai, Nagano, Kanazawa)
Platforms 1–2: Chuo Rapid Line (elevated above main concourse)
floors.tips: Tokaido Shinkansen (blue gates) is operated by JR Central; Tohoku Shinkansen (green gates) is operated by JR East.

floors.name: 1F Ground Concourse & JR Lines
floors.name_ja: 1F 地上改札・在来線ホーム
lines: Platforms 3–4: Yamanote & Keihin-Tohoku (Northbound to Ueno / Omiya)
Platforms 5–6: Yamanote & Keihin-Tohoku (Southbound to Shinagawa / Yokohama)
Platforms 7–10: Tokaido Main Line & Ueno-Tokyo Line
exits: Marunouchi Central / North / South Exits (Imperial Palace & Red Brick Facade)
Yaesu Central / North / South Exits (Highway Buses & Shinkansen)
Nihombashi Exit (Financial district & Expressway buses)
floors.tips: Use the broad Central Passageway to easily cross between Marunouchi (West) and Yaesu (East).

floors.name: B1F Gransta & Subway Connections
floors.name_ja: B1F 地下コンコース・丸ノ内線
lines: Platforms 1–4 (B5F): Sobu & Yokosuka Lines (to Narita Airport / Kamakura)
exits: Marunouchi Underground Central Exit
Yaesu Underground Central Exit
Direct walkway to Otemachi Station (5 subway lines)
floors.tips: Tokyo Character Street is on the Yaesu B1 level; Gransta Tokyo gourmet hall spans the central B1 area.

floors.name: B4F–B5F Keiyo Underground (Disneyland)
floors.name_ja: B4F-B5F 京葉線ホーム（ディズニー方面）
lines: Platforms 1–4: JR Keiyo & Musashino Lines (to Maihama for Tokyo Disney Resort)
floors.tips: The Keiyo Line platform is located 400m south underground. Allow 10–15 minutes walking through moving walkways from the main concourse.

name: Shinjuku Station

exits.name: East Exit
exits.leads_to: Kabukicho, Shinjuku 3-Chome, Omoide Yokocho (Memory Lane), Golden Gai

exits.name: West Exit
exits.leads_to: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building (free observation deck), skyscraper district, Yodobashi Camera

exits.name: South Exit / New South Exit
exits.leads_to: Busta Shinjuku highway bus terminal, Takashimaya Times Square, Shinjuku Gyoen

tips: The world's busiest station with over 200 exits! Pay close attention to yellow overhead exit signs before tapping out.
Changing between JR platforms and the Toei Oedo Line takes about 10–12 minutes down multiple escalators deep underground.
If you need to cross between the East and West sides without entering ticket gates, use the free East-West Underpass (opened 2020).

floors.name: 2F South Concourse & Highway Buses
floors.name_ja: 2F 南口改札・バスタ新宿
exits: South Exit (Lumine 1 & 2)
New South Exit (direct link to Busta)
Koshu-kaido Gate
floors.tips: Highway buses to Mt. Fuji, airports, and other cities depart from Busta Shinjuku on levels 3F and 4F directly above the South Exit.

floors.name: 1F Ground Platforms & East-West Passageway
floors.name_ja: 1F 地上ホーム・東西自由通路
lines: Platforms 9–10: Chuo Limited Express (Azusa / Kaiji to Matsumoto)
Platforms 13–14: Yamanote Line (Inner loop: Shibuya / Shinagawa)
Platforms 15–16: Yamanote Line (Outer loop: Ikebukuro / Ueno)
exits: East-West Free Passageway (connects East & West outside ticket gates)
amenities: Wheelchair accessible elevators to all platforms
floors.tips: Opened in 2020, the broad East-West Free Passageway lets you walk between the East and West sides without entering ticket gates.

floors.name: B1F Underground Concourse & Private Rail
floors.name_ja: B1F 地下改札・私鉄乗換
exits: East Exit (Kabukicho, Omoide Yokocho, Golden Gai)
West Exit (Metropolitan Government skyscrapers, Yodobashi Camera)
floors.tips: Pay close attention to yellow overhead exit signs before tapping out.

floors.name: B3F–B7F Toei Subway Lines (Deep)
floors.name_ja: B3F-B7F 都営地下鉄（大江戸線・新宿線）
lines: Platforms 6–7: Toei Oedo Line (E-27, to Roppongi, Daimon / Tokyo Tower, Tsukiji)
floors.tips: Toei Oedo Line is deep underground (B7F). Allow 10–12 minutes for transfers from JR platforms.

name: Shibuya Station

exits.name: Hachiko Exit
exits.leads_to: Hachiko bronze statue, Shibuya Scramble Crossing, Shibuya 109, Center-Gai

exits.name: Miyamasuzaka Exit
exits.leads_to: Miyashita Park (rooftop park & shopping), Shibuya Hikarie

exits.name: Scramble Square Sky Exit
exits.name_ja: スクランブルスクエア口
exits.leads_to: Shibuya Scramble Square & SHIBUYA SKY observation deck

tips: The Ginza Line platform is elevated on the 3rd floor, whereas the Fukutoshin and Tokyu Toyoko lines are located on basement level B5.
Ongoing station redevelopment means walkways change frequently. Follow the color-coded line signs overhead.

floors.name: 3F Elevated Tokyo Metro Ginza Line
floors.name_ja: 3F 銀座線ホーム
lines: Tokyo Metro Ginza Line (G-01, towards Omotesando, Ginza, Asakusa)
exits: Direct sky-bridge into Shibuya Scramble Square
Direct sky-bridge to Shibuya Hikarie
amenities: Futuristic M-shaped vaulted wave roof concourse
floors.tips: The Ginza Line platform is high above the ground on the 3rd floor, opposite the deep subway lines.

floors.name: 1F Ground Concourse & Scramble Crossing
floors.name_ja: 1F ハチ公改札・スクランブル交差点
lines: Platforms 1–2: JR Yamanote Line (consolidated island platform)
exits: Hachiko Exit (Hachiko Statue, Scramble Crossing, Center-Gai, SHIBUYA109)
South Exit (West bus terminal)
Miyamasuzaka Exit (Miyashita Park rooftop park)
amenities: Hachiko Tourist Information Center (SHIBU HACHI BOX)
floors.tips: The famous Hachiko statue and Scramble Crossing are directly outside the Hachiko Exit.

floors.name: B3F Tokyo Metro Hanzomon & Den-en-toshi Lines
floors.name_ja: B3F 半蔵門線・田園都市線ホーム
lines: Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line (Z-01, towards Otemachi / Skytree)
exits: Underground exits A0–A12 leading directly to SHIBUYA109 and Dogenzaka
floors.tips: Use underground passage A2/A3 to reach SHIBUYA109 without crossing street traffic in rainy weather.

floors.name: B5F Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin & Tokyu Toyoko Lines
floors.name_ja: B5F 副都心線・東急東横線ホーム
lines: Platforms 3–6: Tokyu Toyoko Line (to Yokohama) & Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line (F-16, to Harajuku & Shinjuku-sanchome)
amenities: Express elevator bank to Shibuya Hikarie
floors.tips: Located 5 floors down. High-speed elevators in Shibuya Hikarie provide the fastest route between B5F and street level.

name: Kyoto Station

exits.name: Karasuma (North) Central Exit
exits.leads_to: Kyoto Tower, City Bus Terminal, Grand Central Concourse, Porta underground mall

exits.name: Hachijo (South) Exit
exits.leads_to: Tokaido Shinkansen gates, Kintetsu line (to Nara), Airport Limousine buses

tips: The main city bus terminal for tourist sights (Kinkaku-ji, Kiyomizu-dera, Gion) is located immediately outside the Karasuma (North) Exit.
The JR Sagano Line for Arashiyama departs from platforms 31–33 at the far western end of the main concourse.

floors.name: 2F Shinkansen & Pedestrian Walkway
floors.name_ja: 2F 新幹線改札・南北自由通路
lines: Platforms 11–14: Tokaido Shinkansen (to Tokyo, Nagoya, Shin-Osaka, Hakata)
exits: Hachijo Exit (South side — Airport Limousines & Kintetsu Line to Nara)
North-South Pedestrian Walkway (free public crossing between Karasuma and Hachijo)
floors.tips: The broad North-South Walkway on 2F connects Kyoto Tower (North) and the Shinkansen gates (South) with panoramic views of the main concourse.

floors.name: 1F Main Concourse & Sightseeing Lines
floors.name_ja: 1F 中央口・観光路線ホーム
lines: Platform 0: JR Kyoto Line (Special Rapid to Osaka & Kobe)
Platforms 8–10: JR Nara Line (to Fushimi Inari Taisha, Uji, Nara)
Platforms 31–33: JR Sagano Line (to Arashiyama bamboo grove)
exits: Karasuma Central Exit (Kyoto Tower, City Bus Terminal, Taxi Terminal)
floors.tips: Platforms 31–33 for Arashiyama are at the far western end of the concourse. Platforms 8–10 for Fushimi Inari are on the south-east side.

floors.name: B1F–B2F Subway & Porta Underground Mall
floors.name_ja: B1F-B2F 地下鉄烏丸線・ポルタ地下街
lines: Kyoto City Subway Karasuma Line (K-11, to Shijo, Karasuma-Oike, Kyoto Imperial Palace)
exits: Direct underground exits to Kyoto Tower and Station Plaza
amenities: Kyoto Porta Underground Shopping Mall (over 200 shops)
Subway ticket machines with IC card top-up
floors.tips: The City Bus Terminal outside the Karasuma (North) Exit has buses to Kinkaku-ji, Kiyomizu-dera, and Gion. Buy a day pass or tap Suica/ICOCA.

name: Osaka / Umeda Station

exits.name: Midosuji (North) Exit
exits.leads_to: Grand Front Osaka, Yodobashi Camera Umeda, Lucua shopping mall

exits.name: Central Exit
exits.leads_to: Direct connection between JR platforms, taxi ranks, and underground walkways

exits.name: South Exit
exits.leads_to: Hanshin Department Store, Whity Umeda underground shopping city

tips: The interconnected underground complex is nicknamed the 'Umeda Dungeon'. If disoriented, head to street level to re-orient using Grand Front or Hanshin towers.
The Osaka Loop Line (platform 1 & 2) circles the city and connects directly to Osaka Castle and Universal Studios transfer points.

floors.name: 3F Bridge Gate & Osaka Station City
floors.name_ja: 3F 連絡橋口・大阪ステーションシティ
exits: Bridge Gate (Direct bridge connecting Lucua and Daimaru)
amenities: Toki-no-hiroba (Time and Space Plaza under massive curved roof)
floors.tips: Toki-no-hiroba on 3F offers great panoramic views looking down onto arriving trains.

floors.name: 1F Central Ground Concourse
floors.name_ja: 1F 中央コンコース・地上改札
lines: Platforms 1–2: Osaka Loop Line (to Osaka Castle, Universal City transfer at Nishikujo)
Platforms 3–6: JR Kyoto & Kobe Lines (Special Rapid to Kyoto, Shin-Osaka, Sannomiya)
exits: Central Exit (Main taxi ranks & central walkways)
Midosuji North Exit (Grand Front Osaka, Yodobashi Camera Umeda, Lucua)
South Exit (Hanshin Department Store, Hilton Plaza)
Sakurabashi Exit (West side, Airport buses)
floors.tips: For Universal Studios Japan, take Osaka Loop Line (platform 1) to Nishikujo Station and transfer across platform to JR Yumezaki Line.

floors.name: B1F–B3F 'Umeda Dungeon' & Subways
floors.name_ja: B1F-B3F 地下鉄・阪急・阪神（梅田地下街）
lines: Osaka Metro Midosuji Line (M-16, Umeda Station — red line to Dotonbori / Namba)
Osaka Metro Tanimachi Line (T-20, Higashi-Umeda Station — purple line)
Osaka Metro Yotsubashi Line (Y-11, Nishi-Umeda Station — blue line)
Hankyu Osaka-Umeda Station (express trains to Kyoto-Kawaramachi, Kobe)
Hanshin Osaka-Umeda Station (to Koshien Stadium, Kobe)
exits: Whity Umeda
Diamor Osaka
Do-chika underground mall
floors.tips: Nicknamed 'Umeda Dungeon'. Look for colored overhead signs pointing to line letters: M (Red Midosuji), T (Purple Tanimachi), Y (Blue Yotsubashi).

name: Nara Station

exits.name: East Exit
exits.leads_to: Buses to Nara Park, Todai-ji & Kasuga Taisha; Sanjo-dori shopping street; Tourist Info in historical station building

exits.name: West Exit
exits.leads_to: Hotel Nikko Nara and regional airport buses

tips: Kintetsu-Nara Station is 15 minutes closer on foot to the deer at Nara Park than JR Nara Station. If arriving at JR Nara, take bus #2 from East Exit bus stop #1.
The old Western-style JR station building outside the East Exit houses an excellent multi-lingual Tourist Information Office.

floors.name: 2F Elevated Platforms
floors.name_ja: 2F 高架ホーム
lines: Platforms 1–2: JR Yamatoji Line (Yamatoji Rapid to Tennoji & JR Namba in Osaka)
Platforms 3–4: JR Nara Line (Miyakoji Rapid to Uji & Kyoto)
Platform 5: JR Sakurai Line (Man-yo Mahoroba Line to Tenri & Sakurai)
amenities: Elevators, escalators and stairs down to 1F concourse
floors.tips: Rapid trains to Kyoto (Miyakoji Rapid) take approx 45 minutes; Yamatoji Rapid to Osaka Tennoji takes approx 35 minutes.

floors.name: 1F Concourse, Exits & Deer Park Buses
floors.name_ja: 1F コンコース・奈良公園連絡バス
exits: East Exit (Nara Park, Todai-ji Great Buddha, Kasuga Taisha, Sanjo-dori shopping street)
West Exit (Hotel Nikko Nara, Kansai & Itami Airport limousine buses)
amenities: Historical 1934 Former Station Building (now Tourist Information Center)
floors.tips: Nara Park & Deer: Take City Loop Bus #2 from East Exit Bus Stop #1 (approx 8 minutes to Todai-ji Daibutsuden). Walking along Sanjo-dori takes approx 20–25 minutes.
